statement: Acceptance obligations: The host ledger implements the persistent-active scheduling foundation in [distant-world.md](distant-world.md). / It is gated by the existing `sim.active_regions` switch, enabled in compiled and packaged defaults for v0.3.0. / Budgets remain unlimited in shipped configuration. / Landed consumers include ground objects, regional fields/weather/scent/energy and regional foliage/water; / consumer-specific activation and qualification remain separate from the ledger switch. / Durable completed work and ground-object continuation, durable regional fields/weather/scent/energy and regional foliage/water continuation (issue #242) are implemented for v0.3.2 (in preparation), with native qualification pending. / Regional continuation performance/default enablement is planned for v0.4.0 as [issue #320](https://github.com/d-addison/luminumbra/issues/320). / These consumers retain their individual activation gates. / The dedicated server autosaves every five minutes; / this does not qualify those continuation consumers. / Here “afterwards” refers to the investigation: both fixes were included in the ledger merge.
